# Energy Procurement

Curated by Skill Harbor: a complete energy procurement playbook for commercial and industrial facilities with large annual energy spend. Covers utility bill anatomy (energy, demand, capacity, transmission and distribution, riders), procurement strategies (fixed-price, index, block-and-index, layered procurement), demand charge management (peak identification, load shifting, batteries, demand response programs), renewable procurement (physical and virtual PPAs, RECs, on-site generation), load profiling, market structures (regulated vs deregulated, PJM, ERCOT, CAISO and other ISOs), sustainability reporting (Scope 2, RE100, SBTi), and risk management. Includes decision frameworks for strategy selection, PPA evaluation, demand-charge ROI, and market timing, plus documented edge cases such as the ERCOT Winter Storm Uri price spike and demand ratchet traps, communication patterns for suppliers and internal stakeholders, and escalation protocols. Contribution by evos, listed here with credit. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT); this skill is licensed Apache-2.0. Honest caveats: US market structures throughout, with examples referencing US ISOs and utilities. Numbers and tariffs are illustrative; always ground them in your own bills and forward curves. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
